response.original_title: How to Add a Guest to an Existing Norwegian Cruise Booking
response.overview: To add a guest to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) booking +1-866-254-7549, you must contact NCL directly or reach out to your travel agent +1-866-254-7549 , as this change cannot be completed online through your My NCL account. Important Factors to Know: Cabin and Lifeboat Capacity: Adding a guest depends on whether your stateroom has the physical bed space +1-866-254-7549 and whether that specific section of the ship's lifeboat capacity allows more passengers +1-866-254-7549. Ship Capacity Limits: As a cruise gets closer to being sold out +1-866-254-7549, adding a guest becomes much harder or impossible.
